visual.pie: The 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals (2030 Agenda)

turnos.t: Sustainability has three domains: environmental, social and economic. The three-pillar Venn model treats them as equal overlapping circles. The nested model, now more accepted, puts the economy inside society and both inside the environment, because neither can exist without it.

Seventeen social and environmental goals, with targets, adopted by all UN member states in 2015 as the 2030 Agenda. Strengths: common ground for policy, and they apply to MEDCs and LEDCs alike. Limitations: some goals are too vague to assess, they're built top-down, bureaucracy slows them, and they can ignore local contexts.
